((tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tasks t
  WHERE (t.id = task_source_reads.task_id))))
additional_policies.with_check:
((tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (task_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.task_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tasks t
  WHERE ((t.id = task_source_reads.task_id) AND (t.created_by = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.actor_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (t.status = 'running'::text)))))
